Profile.Profile: Free, open-source tools for people who run their own stuff: home servers, media libraries, consoles. Auditarr: nightly quality control for a Sonarr / Radarr / Bazarr / Plex library that finds broken downloads, wrong languages and missing subtitles while you sleep, fixes what is safe, and never deletes anything outright. Dedupearr: the truth about your storage, which downloads are real hardlinks, second copies, leftovers or orphans, with the evidence per file.
